Read an experiment specification
create_experiment_table_from_spec()
Create a canonical experiment table from a YAML experiment specification

Create folder for experiment
setup_example_experiment()
Set up an experiment folder from a bundled example
create_environments_from_spec()
Create environments from a YAML experiment specification

run_experiment()

Model engines

Direct low-level simulators for advanced use.

simulator_lv_discrete()
Simulate the population dynamics of a community of species using the Lotka-Volterra competition model with temperature-dependent vital rates.
simulator_lv_continuous()
Simulate Lotka-Volterra community dynamics in continuous time
simulator_consumer_resource_continuous()
Simulate consumer-resource dynamics in continuous time
intrinsic_growth_gaussian()
Calculate intrinsic growth rate from species parameters and temperature
